name: omnath, locus of creation
mana cost: {R}{G}{W}{U}
types: legendary creature elemental
power toughness: 4/4
triggered: when CARDNAME enters, draw a card.
triggered: landfall — whenever a land you control enters, you gain 4 life if this is the first time this ability has resolved this turn. if it's the second time, add {R}{G}{W}{U}. if it's the third time, CARDNAME deals 4 damage to each opponent and each planeswalker you don't control.
